etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — kept in hand: to carry on one; to cooperate (提携).
mnemonic: Never sets it down — たずさえる. 携帯: the device this kanji predicted.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 奚 (phonetic ケイ) — the stream in the ravine: mountain torrent.
mnemonic: Water with cliffs for banks — ケイ. 渓谷: the postcard gorge.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 繼): thread (糸) + a phonetic — the thread spliced on: to succeed, inherit.
mnemonic: The line knotted to the next spool — つぐ. 中継 relays; 後継者 inherits.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 巠 (phonetic ケイ) — the plant's vertical line: stem.
mnemonic: The green mast the leaves rig onto — くき. 茎: what the vase actually holds.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 螢): blazing crown + insect (虫) — the bug that carries fire: firefly.
mnemonic: The insect with its own lantern — ほたる. 蛍光灯: fluorescent light, named after it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 奚 (phonetic ケイ) + bird (鳥) — the yard bird: chicken.
mnemonic: The bird on a string in the yard — にわとり. 鶏肉: the menu's plainest kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fish (魚) + 京 (phonetic ゲイ) — the capital-sized fish: whale.
mnemonic: A fish the size of a city — くじら. 鯨: the ocean's metropolis.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a striking phonetic + hand (手) — the blow landed: to strike, attack, shoot.
mnemonic: The hand under the war-cart — うつ. 攻撃, 衝撃, 目撃: strikes physical, emotional, visual.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 桀 (phonetic ケツ) — the one standing above the crowd: outstanding.
mnemonic: Head and shoulders over the grove — ケツ. 傑作: the masterpiece shelf.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — a person who tallies everything: thrifty.
mnemonic: Counts every coin twice — ケン. 倹約: the budget's kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: one hand holding two grain stalks — doing both at once: concurrent.
mnemonic: Two jobs in one fist — かねる. 兼業: the side-hustle kanji, a millennium early.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 僉 (phonetic ケン) + blade (刂) — the double-edged sword: saber.
mnemonic: 刀's formal duelist cousin — つるぎ. 剣道: the way of this kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: enclosure (囗) + 巻 (phonetic ケン) — the drawn circle: sphere, range.
mnemonic: The circle you function inside — ケン. 首都圏, 圏外: the commuter belt, and where your phone gives up.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic ケン) + earth (土) — ground packed hard: solid, steadfast.
mnemonic: Earth you could build a vow on — かたい. 堅実: reliably unexciting, admirably so.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 兼 (phonetic ケン) — suspicion held alongside: dislike, aversion.
mnemonic: Holding the grudge and the smile at once — きらい, いや. 機嫌: the mood dial.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 県 (originally 'to hang') + thread + heart — hung in the air, heart included: suspended, at stake.
mnemonic: The heart dangling by its thread — かかる. 懸命: living like everything hangs on it — because it does.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a rolling phonetic + hand (手) — the hand rolled closed: fist.
mnemonic: The hand packed like a rice ball — こぶし. 拳: じゃんけん's rock, formally.

etymology: Compound: the sacrificial dog (犬) at the tripod — presented upward: to offer, donate.
mnemonic: Placed on the altar with both hands — ケン. 献血: the modern offering, 400ml.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 兼 (phonetic ケン) — speech that holds itself back: humble.
mnemonic: The voice that gives others the credit — ケン. 謙譲語: grammar for bowing.

etymology: Compound: sent down the road (辶) with a charge — to dispatch; care spent (気遣い).
mnemonic: Handed the packet and pointed at the horizon — つかわす. 派遣: dispatch, employment-agency edition.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a bright phonetic + head (頁) — brought into full light: manifest, prominent.
mnemonic: Held up where the light hits it — ケン. 顕微鏡: the microscope, maker of the invisible visible.

etymology: Pictograph: a thread twisted to look reversed — what the eye is tricked into: illusion.
mnemonic: A thread of almost-real — まぼろし. 幻: the pokémon, fittingly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 玄 (phonetic ゲン) — the taut cord: bowstring, instrument string.
mnemonic: The dark line that sings — つる. 弦楽器: strings, orchestral.

etymology: Pictograph: dyed thread hung dark — deep black-red: dark, profound.
mnemonic: The color of deep questions — ゲン. 玄関: the dark threshold; 玄米: rice still in its mystery.

etymology: Phono-semantic: child (子) + 瓜 (phonetic コ) — the child left on the vine: orphan, solitary.
mnemonic: One child, one melon, one field — コ. 孤独: solitude with no exit sign.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 瓜 (phonetic コ) — the bow's curve: an arc.
mnemonic: The bow's shape without the shot — コ. 括弧: brackets — twin arcs holding words.

etymology: Pictograph: the tiger — striped head (虍) and springing legs.
mnemonic: The stripes walk on two strokes — とら. 虎: Osaka's baseball religion.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 夸 'inflate' (phonetic コ) — speech puffed large: to boast; held high: pride (誇り).
mnemonic: Words a size bigger than the facts — ほこる. 誇り: the good kind, worn quietly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 雇 (phonetic コ) + head (頁) — the head turned to what's behind: to review, regard.
mnemonic: The glance over the shoulder at the years — かえりみる. 顧客: the customer you keep looking after.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the drum (壴) and the hand beating it (支) — drum; to rouse (鼓舞).
mnemonic: Stand, skin, stick — つづみ. 鼓動: the chest's house drummer.

etymology: Pictograph: a figure with head thrown back mid-speech — the old state of Wu; in Japanese, to give (呉れる).
mnemonic: The kingdom that keeps giving — くれる. 呉服: kimono cloth, named for Wu's weavers.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 呉 (phonetic ゴ) — delight taken: amusement.
mnemonic: Fun, scheduled — ゴ. 娯楽: the entertainment column.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 吾 'I' (phonetic ゴ) — the heart meeting itself: to realize, awaken.
mnemonic: The moment 'I' and the heart finally agree — さとる. 悟り: satori, this very kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic ゴ) + stone (石) — the game of placed stones: Go.
mnemonic: Stones on the grid — ゴ. 囲碁: territory, one pebble at a time.

etymology: Pictograph: the archery target of the nobles' rite — the rank that shot at it: marquis.
mnemonic: Nobility measured at the archery butt — コウ. 諸侯: the assembled lords.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 亢 (phonetic コウ) — the dug shaft: pit.
mnemonic: The hole with rails going down — コウ. 炭坑: the coal pit of old songs.

etymology: Pictograph: the opening at the infant's crown — an orifice: hole; also Confucius' name (孔子).
mnemonic: The smallest official hole — コウ. 孔: needle-eyes and philosopher-names.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 + 丂 (phonetic コウ) — craft with finesse in it: skillful.
mnemonic: The work with no visible effort — たくみ. 巧妙: cleverness you notice too late.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 亘 (phonetic コウ) — the heart unchanged across time: constant.
mnemonic: Same heart, every visit — コウ. 恒例: the annual, without fail.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 荒 (phonetic コウ) — the heart gone to weeds: flustered.
mnemonic: The heart's tidy field in sudden chaos — あわてる. 慌てる: keys, train, panic.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 亢 (phonetic コウ) — the hand raised against: to resist.
mnemonic: Palm out, neck up — コウ. 抗議: resistance with signatures.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 句 (phonetic コウ) — held fast: to detain; held to details: particular (拘る).
mnemonic: Gripped and not released — コウ. こだわり: the chef's arrest of one ingredient.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 空 (phonetic コウ) — the hand drawn back: to hold off, note down, wait.
mnemonic: Reaching, then pulling back into the empty — ひかえる. 控え室: the waiting room of restraint.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + 攵 'strike' — worked over by force: to attack; to specialize in (専攻).
mnemonic: Engineering applied to the enemy — せめる. 攻略: attack turned into a walkthrough guide.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 工 (phonetic コウ) — originally the Yangtze; in Japan, the inlet: creek.
mnemonic: The workaday waterway — え. 江戸: the inlet-door that became Tokyo.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 共 (phonetic コウ) — all waters at once: flood.
mnemonic: Every river RSVPs yes — コウ. 洪水: the deluge proper.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 冓 (phonetic コウ) — the built channel: ditch; the gap between people (溝ができる).
mnemonic: Water in its assigned lane — みぞ. 溝: also the rift no plumber fixes.

etymology: Pictograph: a seed bursting its shell — the hard casing: armor, shell (甲羅); the first of the ordinal signs.
mnemonic: The shell with a sprout's tail — コウ. 甲乙: ranks A and B; 甲子園: stadium of the first rank.
